cases.scope: Fleet maintenance and roadside support for a 33-unit step van fleet: Ford E350 (700 cu ft) and Freightliner MT55G (600 cu ft), GVWR 10,001–23,000 lbs.
cases.note: Ten years providing commercial fleet maintenance and roadside repair prior to forming the company.

items.quote: They hand back every vehicle with a report and photos. The fleet hasn't gone down for overdue maintenance since.
items.author: Fleet coordinator

items.quote: The diagnosis was spot-on and the warranty is real: a noise came back and they fixed it with no charge, no argument.
items.author: Private truck owner

items.quote: They hit the maintenance windows we agreed on by contract. In this trade, that's not common.
items.author: Transportation manager
